title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Repeat-Placement Load: Training Questions for the Residential Placement Schedule
content:
For new placements priced under the residential placement schedule of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** (Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier), the repeat-placement load reads how many certificates the program issued earlier on the same loan number.

**Rule.** The rated amount of a new placement is multiplied by 1.10 when two or more certificates were issued earlier under the program on the same loan number, by 1.05 when exactly one was, and by 1.00 when none was.

**What counts?** Every issue entry under the program that carries the loan number of the loan being placed, whatever has since become of that certificate — expired, renewed or cancelled. Renewal entries are not issue entries and do not count.

**What does a loan with one earlier certificate pay?** The rated amount multiplied by 1.05.

**And with three earlier certificates?** Two or more: the rated amount multiplied by 1.10.

**And a loan placed for the first time under the program?** None earlier: the multiplier is 1.00.

| Earlier issue entries on the same loan number under the program | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 1.05 |
| 2 or more | 1.10 |
